style: Anime production cel revision replacing the rejected glossy first pass

prompts.prompt: Redraw the referenced guardian as an original hand-drawn Japanese fantasy anime creature production cel. Replace the glossy plush-toy/chibi rendering entirely. Confident fine dark ink contours with deliberate varied line weight; flat local colors with only two hard-edged cel shadow tones; restrained highlights; natural animal proportions, small expressive eyes, expressive silhouette. Artistic restraint, elegant and slightly mysterious, cute through personality rather than infant proportions. NO airbrush shading, no 3D, no plastic shine, no glitter particles, no huge glass eyes, no exaggerated fluffy toy anatomy, no excessive decorative filigree. One full-body creature in three-quarter view facing left, complete silhouette, generous safe margin, true transparent background. No ground, scene, text, watermark or UI. Preserve the species and main color identity but simplify its design substantially. Moonpetal Hare: slender white and pale-lavender rabbit with long rose-tipped ears, small moonstone on forehead and a small crescent tail. Grounded rabbit anatomy and calm alert expression. Remove the excessive petal decoration.
